_comment: Zed → hosted OmniMind MCP. Zed connects to remote MCP servers natively: merge `context_servers` below into Zed's settings.json (zed: open settings) or use Settings → AI → MCP Servers → Add Remote Server — no mcp-remote bridge. The shape is `url` + `headers` (no source/type key); the header is stored in plain text. Without an Authorization header Zed starts the standard MCP OAuth flow instead (only works once the operator enables OAuth mode — docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §9). Zed does not surface MCP elicitation, so destructive tools (memory_supersede, memory_consolidate with dryRun=false) rely on their server-side confirm/dryRun arguments — prefer a read-mostly token here. Token: BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools. Put 'Start with status_get; log decisions with decision_log' in the assistant's default prompt for the freshness contract (docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8).
